title: A projective bundle is separated over its base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal E$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module, and let $\pi:\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)=\operatorname{Proj}_S(\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal E)\to S$ be the associated projective-bundle morphism [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism]. Then $\pi$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism].

proof.text: Let A be the canonical affine-basis symmetric graded algebra of E [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. The projective bundle in [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism] has structure morphism A.relProjHom [def-nagata-relative-proj]. Its grading and coefficientwise base-change proofs are already fields of A, so no separate existential symmetric-algebra comparison is needed here.

Use the directed affine open cover of S. For each affine open U, the chart square supplied by [lemma-nagata-relative-proj-exists] identifies Proj(A(U)) with the fibre product of A.relProjHom and the open immersion U into S [def-pc-fibre-product] and [def-weil-open-immersion]. Flip this square and use its canonical pullback isomorphism: its composite with the second pullback projection is A.toOpen U.

The scheme Proj(A(U)) is separated by [lem-trf-proj-separated]. Hence A.toOpen U is separated by separated cancellation [lem-weil-pbc-separated-cancellation], as implemented by Mathlib Scheme.instIsSeparatedOfIsSeparated. Separatedness respects isomorphisms, so the canonical pullback projection to U is separated as well.

Apply Mathlib IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover for IsSeparated to the directed affine cover. Its separatedness locality instance follows from the diagonal criterion [def-weil-proper-morphism] and closed-immersion locality [lem-weil-pbc-closed-finite-etale-zariski-local]. The separated pullback projections of the preceding step therefore prove separatedness of A.relProjHom. This packages the original diagonal gluing argument without introducing additional statements.
